news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.2% passive stake in Caribou Biosciences via Schedule 13G
news.summary: BlackRock reported a passive Schedule 13G stake of 7,176,404 Caribou Biosciences shares (7.2%) as of June 30, 2026, underscoring the growing institutional ownership base that followed the stock's late-June Russell 2000 inclusion.

news.headline: Caribou executives pitch off-the-shelf CAR-T commercialization case at H.C. Wainwright conference
news.summary: At the H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual Cell Therapy Virtual Conference, CEO Rachel Haurwitz argued vispa-cel is pivotal-ready with a safety profile comparable to liso-cel and a cost structure roughly 96% lower than autologous CAR-T, supporting flexible commercial pricing.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences added to the Russell 2000 Index
news.summary: Caribou was added to the Russell 2000 (and related Russell benchmarks) effective after the June 26, 2026 close as part of FTSE Russell's semi-annual US index reconstitution, expanding its passive and institutional investor base.

news.headline: Caribou shareholders reject officer-exculpation charter amendment at annual meeting
news.summary: At the June 17, 2026 annual meeting, shareholders elected three Class II directors (Andrew Guggenhime, David Johnson, Nancy Whiting) and ratified Deloitte & Touche as auditor, but voted down a proposed charter amendment that would have expanded liability exculpation for company officers.

news.headline: Wall Street sharply raises CRBU price targets after EHA 2026 data
news.summary: Following the positive CB-011 and vispa-cel EHA readouts, H.C. Wainwright raised its target to $9 from $3 and Citi raised its target to $8 from $5, both reiterating bullish ratings on the durability of the new data.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences Reports Dose Escalation Durability Data for CB-011 at EHA 2026
news.summary: In BCMA-naive relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients treated with the allogeneic anti-BCMA CAR-T CB-011, a single dose produced an 83% complete response rate, 91% MRD negativity, and 50% of patients remained in ≥CR at 15 months.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Based on prior reporting cadence and consensus estimates, Caribou is expected to report Q2 2026 financials and give a pipeline/cash-runway update around August 11-12, 2026; exact date not yet formally announced.

catalysts.label: ANTLER-3 pivotal trial initiation (vispa-cel)
catalysts.detail: Caribou has reached FDA alignment on the design of ANTLER-3, a planned randomized Phase 3 trial of vispa-cel in ~250 second-line LBCL patients; initiation is pending securing additional funding for the study.

catalysts.label: CB-011 dose-expansion data (CaMMouflage trial)
catalysts.detail: Caribou has guided to initial data from the dose-expansion portion of the CaMMouflage Phase 1 trial evaluating CB-011 in BCMA-naive and BCMA-exposed relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Financing / capital raise
catalysts.detail: Management has flagged the need for additional capital to fully fund a vispa-cel pivotal trial beyond its current cash runway (guided into 2H 2027); a dilutive offering, partnership, or non-dilutive financing is a watch item.

catalysts.label: ASH 2026 Annual Meeting
catalysts.detail: The American Society of Hematology annual meeting is a likely venue for updated CB-011/vispa-cel clinical data, consistent with Caribou's pattern of presenting at major hematology congresses.

pulse: Caribou Biosciences delivered strong mid-June 2026 EHA data for both lead allogeneic CAR-T programs -- CB-011 in multiple myeloma (83% CR, 91% MRD-negativity) and vispa-cel in second-line lymphoma (82% ORR, 17.1-month mPFS) -- which drove sharp analyst price-target increases and support a planned Phase 3 ANTLER-3 registrational trial for vispa-cel; management used a late-June H.C. Wainwright conference to argue vispa-cel is pivotal-ready with a cost structure far below autologous CAR-T. Despite the clinical progress, Russell 2000 inclusion, and a fresh BlackRock 7.2% passive stake disclosed July 27, the stock continues to trade around $1.8-1.9 as investors focus on the capital still needed to fund a pivotal trial, with cash guided only into 2H 2027. The next things to watch are Q2 2026 earnings (expected around August 11) and any financing or partnering news that would de-risk the vispa-cel registrational path.
